attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "This makes the workflow cancellation token actually functional (previously a non-cancelable dummy token was passed), which changes real execution behavior of the widely-used core Workflows engine, sealing WorkflowExecutionContext and adding an undisposed CancellationTokenSource that could leak resources across many workflow executions."}

reason: This makes the workflow cancellation token actually functional (previously a non-cancelable dummy token was passed), which changes real execution behavior of the widely-used core Workflows engine, sealing WorkflowExecutionContext and adding an undisposed CancellationTokenSource that could leak resources across many workflow executions.
